rule: This file is a TASK PLAN, not a log. Completed work and history live in git log and docs/HONEST_NEGATIVE_CATALOG.md; nothing finished stays here. Every task has a numeric done_when. Nothing is marked DONE without an artifact path.
scope: CFM / generative line only. Predictive line: docs/PREDICTIVE_LINE_INDEX.md.
principle: Do not iterate the model blindly. Gate each module on its own function, then gate the seams between modules. A module that cannot pass its own gate is a bug to fix, not a result to report. Fix order is by measured severity, not by convenience.

module_gates.check: For every training batch: x_t == (1-t)*x0 + t*x1 elementwise, v_target == x1 - x0, and x0's per-atom std matches flow.fm_noise_sigma.
Hold a fixed batch, perturb ONE conditioning input at a time, measure the relative change in the velocity output: swap the metal atom's identity, shift t by 0.25, swap an atom type.
module_gates.pass: each of the three produces ||dv|| / ||v|| > 1e-2. A conditioning channel that moves the output by 0 is not connected.
module_gates.why: The velocity field is called as fm_velocity(x, t, z, cloud_sizes, pocket_embed). Metal identity enters ONLY through the atomic-number embedding; there is no per-cloud metal descriptor and no metal id embedding. If that path is weak the field can only learn the metal marginal.

module_gates.check: One fixed batch, 2,000 optimizer steps, no regularisers. Measure train MSE against the v=0 baseline (mean-squared target norm) for velocity_head in {radial, vector_channels}.
module_gates.pass: train MSE <= 10% of the v=0 baseline for the head we ship
module_gates.known: Wf-A108a measured radial best-possible 5.783 against a v=0 baseline of 10.652 on one 8-cloud batch, i.e. radial's own ceiling is 54% of baseline and the trained model never reaches it.

module_gates.check: On a held-out batch at several t, report ||v_pred|| / ||v_target|| and the regression slope of v_pred on v_target.
module_gates.why: Wf-A108h reported |v| = 0.116-0.159 across t on the readout cohort. If the target norm is O(3), the field is emitting a few percent of the required magnitude, which makes the MSE look like 'the prior' regardless of what the network learned. Highest-yield check in the list.

module_gates.check: One backward from fm_term alone; per-parameter-block grad norm for vel_field.*, head.*, pocket_encoder.*.
module_gates.pass: no parameter block has grad norm 0, and none is more than 100x another block's

module_gates.check: Fix x and z, sweep t over 101 points in [0,1], record the velocity.
module_gates.pass: the output changes by more than 10% of its own norm across the sweep, smoothly. A field flat in t cannot represent a flow.
module_gates.why: vel_field.time_mlp is Linear(1->128) -> SiLU -> Linear(128->128) on the RAW scalar t; the sinusoidal embedding (t_embedding_dim) is opt-in and defaults to 0.

module_gates.check: List which parameters tmQM pretraining does NOT transfer.
module_gates.pass: no missing key may be an atom embedding, a time MLP, or a velocity head; those must be listed explicitly if they are
module_gates.known: The load log reports 47/51 transferred, 4 missing, and the 4 have never been named.

module_gates.check: Run the trainer's velocity call and the ODE sampler's velocity call on the same (x, t, z, cloud_sizes); compare bit-exactly.
From loss_terms, each weighted term's share of the total, per epoch.
module_gates.pass: no single term above 90% of the total; every term declared in the config appears non-zero
module_gates.known: c7 epoch 0: fm_term 12.6 of a 13.7 total (92%), bond_ce 1.0 (7%), everything else under 1%.

module_gates.check: Every reported generation metric names the checkpoint hash, the split fingerprint and the sampler settings; the checkpoint on disk is the one the run wrote.
module_gates.pass: hash + split fingerprint match, and the checkpoint exists at the path the artifact names

tasks.what: Implement the ten gates as molmetal/scripts/cfm_module_gates.py with --gate M1..M10 and --json, each emitting PASS/FAIL plus the measured numbers.
tasks.done_when: all ten gates run against a checkpoint and emit a JSON artifact

tasks.what: Run G1 on the 5-epoch vector_channels checkpoint and on the c8 full-corpus checkpoint.
tasks.done_when: two JSON artifacts, every gate PASS or FAIL with numbers

tasks.what: Fix every FAILing gate, highest severity first. Candidates already identified: (a) output scale of the radial head — tanh(x)*vel_scale*(x-centroid) bounds |v| by the centroid radius and is the default for every full-corpus run; (b) replace the raw-scalar time_mlp with the existing sinusoidal t_embedding_dim path; (c) give the field an explicit per-cloud metal embedding instead of relying on the atomic-number embedding alone; (d) name and fix the 4 parameters tmQM pretraining does not transfer.
tasks.done_when: the failing gate flips to PASS under the same protocol, and the fix is a config key wherever possible (AGENTS.md 5.11)

tasks.what: Re-run the 125-step regime arm with the fixes on, against the Wf-A108h baseline (fm_term 12.260 -> 12.237, field 8.928 vs v=0 9.008).
tasks.done_when: fm_term falls by more than 10% in 125 steps, or the arm is a measured no-op with the gate numbers that explain why

tasks.what: Full-corpus run with the fixed model: batch 64, 18 epochs, same split as c7.
tasks.done_when: checkpoint on disk + per-epoch metrics + generation pool, and the field beats v=0 by a margin that survives a seed repeat

tasks.what: Three seeds of the R1 config.
tasks.done_when: per-seed numbers with a paired test, not a 5-point bootstrap

tasks.what: Generation pool quality on the R1 checkpoint: validity, uniqueness, novelty, SA, QED, ring profile, metal retention.
tasks.done_when: one artifact per metric with the checkpoint hash attached (M10)

tasks.what: Paper-ready documentation: one results document where every number carries its artifact path, plus a claims table.
tasks.done_when: docs/CFM_RESULTS.md exists and every number in it is machine-checked against an artifact

running_now.note: Reference arm, not the fixed arm. Its checkpoint is needed because c7's was lost. Do not treat its numbers as the model's ceiling.
